hooks.command:
INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'git commit'; then MSG=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_result.stdout // empty'); if echo "$MSG" | grep -q '^content:'; then echo '
-----
REMINDER: This was a content commit. Update EntryReferenceDocument.md with the new entry UUID, severity, and category.
-----'; fi; fi

INPUT=$(cat); F=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$F" in *Content/toxins.json|*Content/diseases.json) OUT=$(python3 /Users/cristianofontes/Desktop/PetToxic/Scripts/validate_content.py --quiet 2>&1) || { echo "$OUT" | tail -40 >&2; exit 2; };; esac
